description: This file defines types, constants, and functions for configuring memory-related features in a project, including handling of embedding models, database paths, and environment variable resolution.

methods.name: resolveDefaultDbPath
methods.description: Resolves the default database path, checking for existing directories and falling back to a preferred path.

methods.name: assertAllowedKeys
methods.description: Checks if an object contains only allowed keys, throws an error if unknown keys are found.

methods.name: vectorDimsForModel
methods.description: Returns the vector dimensions for a given embedding model, throws an error if the model is unsupported.

methods.name: resolveEnvVars
methods.description: Replaces environment variable placeholders in a string with their actual values.

methods.name: resolveEmbeddingModel
methods.description: Determines the embedding model to use based on the provided embedding configuration.
